newsitem.title: USA: Franklin sets four-for-one stock div.
newsitem.headline: Franklin sets four-for-one stock div.

text.p: Franklin Credit Management Corp said its board approved a four-for-one stock dividend payable on September 1 to shareholders of record on August 20.
The company said it will issue an additional four shares for every share outstanding.
"The proposed stock dividend is intended to improve the market float and marketability of the stock," said chief executive Thomas Axon in a statement.
A Franklin spokesman said the stock has not been trading much because "it's held by owners who are not releasing it, because they feel the company is in terrific shape."
